# 1 # Extension Must Be Active: V
# Many important RISC-V extensions are currently active.
# Test Case Name: ADD
# Test Case Type: INSTRUCTION
# Test Case Rule: RULE 1: In the RV64I ISA, the ADD instruction MUST add its two source registers as 64-bit integers and write the 64-bit sum to the destination register.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
li t0, 0x5
li t1, 0xa
add t2, t0, t1
# Result: t2 = 15

# 104 # Extension Must Be Active: V
# Many important RISC-V extensions are currently active.
# Test Case Name: BLTU
# Test Case Type: INSTRUCTION
# Test Case Rule: RULE 1: BLTU MUST be a branch instruction that performs an unsigned-less-than comparison of the unsigned integer values in its first source register and its second source register.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
li t0, 0x0
li t1, 0x5
li t2, 0xa
bltu t1,t2,taken
li t0, 0x0
j end
taken:
li t0, 0x1
end:
# Result: t0 = 1

# Test Case Rule: RULE 1: When the source element of VFRSQRT7.V is a finite negative value (-∞ ≤ x < -0.0), VFRSQRT7.V produces a canonical NaN and raises the invalid operation (NV) exception.
##### ASSEMBLY #####

# Result: a0 = 0x10

# Test Case Rule: RULE 1: A VROR.VI instruction executed with an immediate rotate amount equal to the modular negation of a desired left-rotate amount produces the same architectural result as a rotate-left immediate operation would have produced, because no VROL.VI immediate form is defined.

# Result: a0 = 0

# 3690 # Extension Must Be Active: V
# Many important RISC-V extensions are currently active.
# Test Case Name: VS1R.V
# Test Case Type: INSTRUCTION
# Test Case Rule: RULE 2: VS1R.V computes its effective vector length evl as VLEN divided by EEW and uses this evl regardless of the current vtype configuration and the current vl setting.
##### ASSEMBLY #####
li t1, 0x10 # AVL = 16
vsetvli zero, t1, e8, m1, ta, ma # SEW=8, LMUL=1, set VL=16
li t3, 0xaa # value to broadcast
vmv.v.x v1, t3 # fill v1 with 0xAA in all bytes
li t2, 0x1 # AVL = 1
vsetvli zero, t2, e32, m1, ta, ma # SEW=32, LMUL=1, set VL=1
la a0, mem_buf # base address for store
sd x0, 0(a0)
sd x0, 8(a0)
vs1r.v v1, (a0) # store vector register using effective length
addi t4, a0, 15
lb a1, 0(t4) # load the 16th byte written
mem_buf:
# Result: a1 = 170
